Res.Caption: Container Condition
Res.FullDescription: The condition in which the container was received/released by the depot.

Res.Caption: Container Is Empty
Res.FullDescription: Was the container empty when it was received/released by the depot.

Res.Caption: Container Quality
Res.FullDescription: The quality of container at the time it was received/released by the depot.

Res.Caption: Detention Days
Res.FullDescription: The number of days the container was in detention at the time it was received.

Res.Caption: Movement Date
Res.FullDescription: The date of the container movement.

Res.Caption: Address
Res.FullDescription: The address of the depot/wharf/yard that announced the movement.

Res.Caption: Override Responsible Party
Res.FullDescription: An override of the party responsible for the container should it be delivered/returned late. If this is not set then the responsible party will come from the attached bills of lading.

Res.Caption: Other Location
Res.FullDescription: A location other that of the depot.

Res.Caption: Created Time (UTC)
Res.FullDescription: The date and time this movement was entered into the system. The time is shown in UTC time.

Res.Caption: Created By
Res.FullDescription: The user who entered this movement into the system.
